name: Return Prime
shortInfo: Helps Shopify brands automate returns and exchanges
brief: Manage your Shopify store's returns and exchanges efficiently with this plug and play solution and drive more revenue per return.
about: Return Prime is a returns and refunds management solution for online businesses. Return Prime helps online sellers to enhance operational efficiency by creating smooth customer experiences and consolidating and simplifying all return related processes.
